scenario.description: Patient asks about a statement balance.
scenario.goal: Patient directed to billing with clear next steps.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I got a bill for $85, what is that for?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Billing handles statements. I can transfer you or have them call back. Which do you prefer?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I've sent a callback request to billing for today.
